member.name: T:CreditRisk.CreditAnalysis.Worker.Consumers.CreditProposalCreatedEventConsumer
member.summary: Consumes CreditProposalCreatedEvent and orchestrates credit analysis workflow. Fetches bureau data, scores the proposal using CreditScoringEngine, and publishes CreditProposalEvaluatedEvent via Outbox.

member.name: M:CreditRisk.CreditAnalysis.Worker.Consumers.CreditProposalCreatedEventConsumer.Consume(MassTransit.ConsumeContext{CreditRisk.Shared.Contracts.CreditAnalysis.Events.CreditProposalCreatedEvent})

member.name: M:CreditRisk.CreditAnalysis.Worker.Services.BureauHttpClient.QueryAsync(System.String,System.String)

member.name: T:CreditRisk.CreditAnalysis.Worker.Services.OutboxProcessor
